driver_floors.note: The minimum NVIDIA Linux driver for each CUDA major version under CUDA minor version compatibility, as NVIDIA documents it. A newer driver also runs older CUDA versions through backward compatibility. Minor version compatibility has documented limits: PTX that the driver must JIT-compile needs the driver of the toolkit that produced it, and some features span the toolkit and the driver.
